# sevenx_classes, the content classes package

This page is for developers and administrators who need to know which general content classes a `sevenx_multisite`
installation has and where they come from. It answers: what the `sevenx_classes` package contains, how it is
installed, and what the installer changes in these classes afterwards. The site-specific `ng_*` classes are on
[The demo content packages](the-demo-content-packages.md).

## Contents

1. [The package](#the-package)
2. [The classes](#the-classes)
3. [How the package is installed](#how-the-package-is-installed)
4. [What the installer changes afterwards](#what-the-installer-changes-afterwards)
5. [History](#history)

## The package

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Name | `sevenx_classes` |
| Summary | sevenx content classes |
| Type | `contentclass` |
| Install type | `install` (`<package ... install_type="install">`) |
| Version | number `6.0`, release `10-stable`; `<ezpublish><version>` `6.0.10-stable` |
| License | `GPL`, text in `documents/LICENCE` |
| Files | `package.xml`, `documents/LICENCE`, 33 files `ezcontentclass/class-<identifier>.xml` |
| Required by | `sevenx_multisite`, `sevenx_multisite_clean`, `sevenx_site`, `sevenx_site_clean` |

Its `<provides>` list has 34 entries because `file` is listed twice; there are 33 class files and 33
`<install>` items, and the same 33 items under `<uninstall>`. The published archive of 6.0.15 is
[sevenx_classes.ezpkg](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/sevenx_classes.ezpkg).

The datatypes come from extensions: `ezsrrating` from `ezstarrating`, `ezgmaplocation` from `ezgmaplocation`,
`xrowmetadata` from `xrowmetadata`. The installer's `preInstall()` registers the first two (and `ngenhancedlink`,
`eztags`) in `content.ini [DataTypeSettings]` for the running process before the packages are installed, and lists
all three extensions in `ActiveExtensions`; see [Extensions it activates](extensions-it-activates.md).

## How the package is installed

The setup installs required packages before the site package's post-install runs (see
[Dependencies and install order](../basics/dependencies-and-install-order.md)). `CreateSites` installs them with
`'non-interactive' => true` (`kernel/setup/steps/ezstep_create_sites.php`). In that mode
`eZContentClassPackageHandler` (`kernel/classes/packagehandlers/ezcontentclass/ezcontentclasspackagehandler.php`)
skips a class whose remote id already exists: "Non-interactive installs (e.g. CLI) must not destructively replace
existing classes and their content objects."

Six of the 33 classes carry the same remote id as a class of the kernel's base data (`share/db_data.dba`):
`article`, `comment`, `file`, `folder`, `image` and `link`. On a new installation these six keep the base data's
definition; the other 27 are created from the package.

> **Note**
> When you import `sevenx_classes` by hand into an existing site, the class handler offers the choices of its
> `ERROR_EXISTS` conflict: replace, skip, create a new class, or update the existing class ("attributes are added and
> updated, none removed"). See [Import versus install](../basics/import-versus-install.md).

## What the installer changes afterwards

`sevenxMultiSiteInstaller` adjusts some of these classes during the install:

| Step | Class | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `preInstall()` | `folder` | adds `tags` ("Tags", ezkeyword) and `publish_date` ("Publish date", ezdatetime), named in the primary language |
| `preInstall()` | `user` (base data) | adds `two_factor` ("Two-step sign-in", datatype `sevenxauthentication2fa`) when `extension/sevenx_authentication_2fa` exists |
| post-install `updateClassAttributes` | `folder` | renames `short_description` to "Summary" and `show_children` to "Display sub items" |
| post-install `updateTemplateLookClassAttributes` | `template_look` (base data) | adds twelve attributes such as `site_map_url`, `footer_text`, `hide_powered_by`, `footer_script` |
| post-install `removeClassAttribute` | `template_look` | removes the attribute `id` |

Two repair steps then rebuild class name lists that were stored under a number instead of a language code
(`postInstallResyncContentClassNames`, `postInstallRepairClassNameLists`); see [Post-install fixes](post-install-fixes.md).

## History

The git history of `packages/sevenx_classes` starts on 2024-01-13 ("Renamed Key Site Package Internal Directories
For Initial Editing and Improvments To Begin"), when the folder `packages/ezwebin_classes` was renamed to
`packages/sevenx_classes` (`git log --follow` shows the rename). Later commits switched every class to an `eng-US` translation (2024-01-13), gave the article, image and
product classes a star rating attribute (2024-02-27), added `xrowmetadata` to most page classes (2024-04-02), added
the `review` class (2026-09-12) and made `product` a container (2026-09-30).
